notes.title: Bug Fix #5 - Better Boundaries
notes.content: Okay boundaries should be 100% impossible to get out of now

notes.title: Bug Fix #4 - Tighter Boundaries
notes.content: Should be much harder to get out of bounds and once you are, you should be immediately snapped back in bounds.

notes.title: Bug Fix #3 - Double Death patch
notes.content: Dying twice in one frame was desyncing player stats, causing them to potentially trigger the anti-cheat as an invalid score.

notes.title: Leaderboard fix 2!
notes.content:
Was previously requesting leaderboard ID's 0-9, 10-19, etc- when I should've been requesting 1-10, 11-20, etc
Off by one errors do be a lil silly :3

notes.title: Leaderboard bug fix
notes.content: Fixed issue with the Friends leaderboard showing your global ranking instead of your ranking among friends
